get.description: What Mado downloads to work with, and whether each is ready.

post.description: Starts downloading a tool, unless it's ready or already on its way.

put.description:
Keeps the owner's choices. Search reads the words again with a reader of words chosen,
PP-OCRv6 fetched for Best the first time it's chosen.

get.description: The library's folders, in the order they were added, each with the folders inside it.

post.description: Adds a folder to the library, reads it and watches it. Nothing in it changes.

delete.description:
Takes a folder out of the library, with Mado's copies of its pictures. The pictures
themselves stay exactly where they are.

get.description: The library in numbers, for Home.

The pictures that won't open, but those the owner marked as damaged: each with why. They
were left exactly as they are.

The drives the library's folders are on, the one with the most of its pictures first:
what's free, what the pictures use, what waits in quarantine and what the queue wants.

A page of the pictures, by the day they were taken: newest first, or oldest. `after` is
where the page before ended. A picture kept from a group of duplicates or a burst says
which, and a favourite says so.

One picture, with everything Mado read of it. One from outside the library, which no
scan looks after, is looked at as it is now: read again once its file changed (a Save in its
place, say), 404 with why once it went; and it counts as opened again, its month before it's
forgotten starting afresh. A camera RAW waiting for Mado's RAW reader asks for it.

The pictures either side of one, in the list it was opened from: none for one outside
the library, which isn't in a list, unless it was opened from the favourites. Opened from a
search's results, or More like this, they're its neighbours there, in the results' order.
Its thumbnail, about 512 pixels on its longer side (WebP).

It the size of a screen, at most 2560 pixels on its longer side (WebP): a camera RAW
developed, as Save makes it.

It at full size: the picture itself when the window can show its format, else a copy it
can (PNG).

put.description:
Gives a picture a heart, or takes it back: a favourite, in the library or from outside it,
which the daily wallpaper can change to. The picture itself stays exactly as it is.

post.description:
Marks a picture that won't open as damaged: it isn't asked about again, unless its file
changes. The picture itself stays exactly as it is.

Reads one picture again now (one that wouldn't open may have been mended since). A camera
RAW is read by Mado's RAW reader, which it asks for while it isn't there.

Opens what's given: one picture as Mado knows it (the library's, or one outside the
library, read now), with what else was given and left out; several, or a folder, as Many at
once would take them. 404 or 422, with why, when none of it is a picture.

Keeps a picture pasted from the clipboard (its bytes, as the window has them: PNG) in
Mado's data folder, never the owner's, and says it as a picture outside the library; the
same picture pasted again is the one kept already. 413 for one too big, 422 for what isn't a
picture.

get.description: The sizes a picture can be made for: the devices' screens, the owner's own and prints.

post.description: Remembers this PC's screens, as the window sees them, and says which Mado knows now.

How a picture would be made to a recipe: its shape, the model, its look, about how long it
takes here and how it would be saved.

A preview of the picture made: all of it no bigger than `fit` (from its view the size of a
screen), or a part of it at full detail (`region`); before (the picture only stretched) or
after (made, as Save would, with its look and touches). All of it comes as JPEG, quick to
make as looks are gone through (WebP when it has see-through parts); a part as WebP.

What a picture made would be saved as, and about how big it would be: a pasted one, into
the owner's Pictures folder till another is chosen.

Makes a picture to its recipe and saves it as the owner chose, as a job: its progress,
the time left and Cancel come from /jobs. A picture waiting in a quarantine is opened to look
at only, and a pasted one is saved only as a new picture, into a folder chosen.

Picks parts: the first click reads the picture (about a fifth of a second on the card),
every click after that is a few hundredths of a second, on the processor.
Makes the edits (the last one new), so the previews show them; nothing is saved.

A small copy of the picture as its edits leave it, in a look: the Looks tab's, once the
Edit tab has made edits (without any, it asks for the kept copy by GET).

get.description:
A small copy of the picture in a look, made from its thumbnail (a camera RAW's from its
view, developed as its stage shows it, as its thumbnail is its camera's own rendering): WebP,
kept by the window (its address carries the picture's version and the look's).
Mado's looks and the owner's own.

post.description: Keeps the mix on the Looks tab (a look, its strength and its touches) as a look.
Keeps a .cube file as one of the owner's looks, named after its title or its file.

put.description: Gives one of the owner's looks a new name.

delete.description:
Deletes one of the owner's looks. Pictures made with it stay as they are. Not while a
recipe uses it, or pictures waiting in the queue are made with it.

get.description:
The latest pictures' own Saves, newest first: a picture's (`picture`), or those waiting
or under way (`active`). A batch's pictures are the queue's (/queue).
The jobs waiting while their pictures are open in another app, the longest first.

post.description: A picture waiting while it's open in another app is tried again now.

A picture waiting while it's open in another app isn't made after all: it's left as it is,
to try again later, and the others go on.

Cancels a job: one waiting at once, one under way at its next step (a tile, or before it
saves). Nothing is saved. One saving its picture is past cancelling, and goes on.

The pictures a batch would be made of: those ticked, a folder's, what a search found, or
the pictures in files and folders dropped or picked, with those left out and why.

What a batch would take: about how long, how much space, and what's free there, by this
PC's speeds and what See it first found; its steps in words, and where its pictures go.

Makes three of a batch's pictures in full, but doesn't save them: timed and sized, to see
first. `round` asks for three others.

get.description: How See it first's three are coming on.

delete.description: Lets See it first's three go: the one being made stops.

get.description:
One of See it first's pictures: a copy of it before and after (WebP), or as it was made,
in full, to look at closely.

post.description:
Puts a batch in the queue: now, after what's in it, or tonight from 23:00. See it first's
pictures made to the same steps are kept rather than made again.

get.description:
Batches done that Home tells of: made in the last week, not cancelled, not yet seen. A
watch folder's aren't: they come as pictures arrive, and History and Made today have them.

post.description: Home's card for a batch done was seen: it goes.

get.description: The queue as its page shows it. `all` lists every picture waiting and done.
The queue in a word: the batch being made and how far it's got, or how many wait.

post.description: Pauses the queue: the picture being made stops at its next tile, first in line again.

Cancels everything in the queue: what waits, and the picture being made at its next tile.
Pictures made already stay, and History has them.
Ticked pictures waiting go next, together.
Ticked pictures waiting go to the end of the queue, together.
Ticked pictures waiting come out of the queue, as if they'd never been put in.
On a drive without room, the pictures that fit are made, and the rest wait for room.
Clears what didn't work of the batches done from the Queue. History still says which.
A picture that didn't work goes back in the queue, at its end.

get.description: The owner's recipes, each with its steps in words and how often and when it was used.

post.description: Keeps steps and how they save as a recipe.

put.description: Changes a recipe: batches in the queue make what they were asked for.

delete.description: Deletes a recipe; batches made from it keep their steps.

get.description:
The watch folders: each one's recipe, where its new pictures go, on or off, and when it
last made pictures.

schema.title: Response Watch Folders Watch Folders Get

post.description: Watches a folder from now: what's in it already is left alone.

put.description: Changes a watch folder, or turns it on or off: on again, it takes what arrives from now.

delete.description: Stops watching a folder: its pictures, and what it made, stay as they are.

get.description:
The groups found, newest first (a page of them: `offset`, `limit`; `kind` for only
duplicates or only bursts), with what setting all of them of that kind aside would do.
`limit=0` asks only for the counts (Home). `reach` makes the page long enough to hold that
group (its key), as the Library's tag opens the review there.

put.description:
Which of a group to keep, one or more of it: the owner's choice among its pictures as
they saw them (`members`); one that joined since is left to Mado.

post.description: A group's pictures aren't the same: Mado doesn't ask again, unless one of them changes.

Sets aside the rest of each group as the review showed it (or of every group of a kind,
as long as none changed since the review saw them, `version`): each picture into its own
drive's quarantine for 30 days, with a line of History, all under one line. A group that
changed since it was shown, and a picture that changed since it was compared, is open in
another app or is on a drive that isn't connected, is left as it is, and said so.

get.description:
What the Library's search box finds, in a folder or the whole library (or the
favourites): pictures whose words match, those that look like what was described (SigLIP's
score past its cut, best first), and those with every word in their name. Fetches what
reading needs, the first time the library is searched.

The library's pictures most like one, by what SigLIP read of each, nearest first: read
now when it hasn't been yet. 404 for a picture that isn't in the library.
How far reading the library for search has got, and what it waits for.

post.description: Pauses reading the library after the picture it's on, till it's asked to go on.
Goes on reading the library.

get.description:
The studio as it is: the monitors now, the pictures chosen and where they're cut, each
part as it'll be made, the latest wallpaper set or saved, the owner's own and the daily
change.

put.description: One for each monitor, or one across all, and the gap for the bezels.
The picture for a monitor (or for all of them), where it's cut, and Fast or Best.

delete.description: A monitor's picture let go (or the one across all).

post.description:
Makes each part at exactly its monitor's pixels, then sets them as Windows' wallpaper:
the owner's own kept first. The making is a small job before the queue's pictures.

Makes the parts, then saves them (or one picture of the whole arrangement) as new
pictures into the folder the owner picked, each in History, as any Save.
The wallpaper being made to set or save, stopped: nothing is set, and what it made goes.

The owner's own wallpaper back, on every monitor or one: their own file, or Mado's copy
of it when it's gone; Windows' slideshow started again, as Windows allows. Every monitor put
back stops the daily change too.

put.description:
The daily change: on or off, its time (07:00 at first), one for each monitor or one
across all, and from the favourites or a library folder.

get.description:
What Windows shows on a monitor now, small (WebP), when it names a file that's there.
The file is only read.

What Mado did on its latest days with anything on them (a week's worth), newest first.
`before` ("2026-11-15", the page's `older`) asks for the days before that one, and `q` for
what names a picture or folder.

post.description:
Undoes a whole batch: its new pictures taken away (into quarantine), or its originals put
back. Each picture's own line says why one couldn't be. Not while some of its pictures are
still in the queue: what's made after would be left as it is.
Undoes a batch's undo: its new pictures put back, or its originals replaced again.

Puts back every picture a review set aside, newest first, each where it was; the library
reads them again. Each picture's own line says why one couldn't be.

get.description: The pictures made today, newest first, for Home.

schema.title: Response Made Today History Today Get

get.description:
A thumbnail of the picture a line made (WebP): the library's, or made now from the picture
itself when it's outside the library. Only a picture Mado made.

post.description:
Takes a new picture away (into quarantine, put back from here), puts a replaced original
back (the made picture going into quarantine in its place), or puts a picture set aside from
its duplicates back where it was (the library reads it again).

Puts a new picture that was taken away back where it was, or replaces an original put
back again (the original going into quarantine once more).

Forgets what Mado did before the last day, week or month, or all of it. What still waits
in quarantine stays, so it can be put back, and no picture changes.

get.description: What waits in quarantine on each drive.

post.description:
Deletes everything set aside on a drive now, before its days are up: it can't be put
back. History says so.
Tests this PC again, timing each model, in the background.

get.description: How big each part of Mado's data is.

post.description:
Writes the export zip (the database, its settings and a manifest) into a folder, never
over another file.
Makes a backup now, checked like the nightly ones (and kept apart from them).

Puts an export's records in place as the engine starts again, the way a backup is
restored: the app starts it again right after asking.
Restores a backup as the engine starts again: the app starts it again right after.

get.description:
Whether Mado's records are damaged, and what can bring them back; null while they're
fine.

post.description:
Restores the newest backup that opens over the damaged records, which are kept beside it
as they are. The app starts the engine again right after.

Sets the damaged records aside as they are, so Mado starts again with new ones, as on its
first day. The app starts the engine again right after.

Area.title: Area
Area.description: A part of the picture, as fractions of it: past 0 and 1 where its edges are drawn.

BatchLine.title: BatchLine
BatchLine.description: A batch as History's one line for it: what it made, and what undoes all of it.

BatchSaving.title: BatchSaving
BatchSaving.description:
How a batch saves: new pictures (beside the originals, into a folder by name beside each,
or into a folder of their own), or in the originals' places, each original to quarantine.

BlurIn.title: BlurIn
BlurIn.description: Blur what's behind what's picked, as a big camera lens would.

ClickIn.title: ClickIn
ClickIn.description:
A click on the picture, as fractions of it: one that picks (`keep`) or, with Alt, one that
takes away.

CutOutIn.title: CutOutIn
CutOutIn.description: Cut out what's picked: on nothing, a colour, or the rest blurred.

CutoutStep.title: CutoutStep
CutoutStep.description:
Cut out the subject, found without a click: Fast, Best, or as this PC suits; with nothing,
a colour or the rest of the picture blurred behind it.

Damage.title: Damage
Damage.description: Mado's records are damaged: what's wrong, and the newest backup that opens.

DriveSpace.title: DriveSpace
DriveSpace.description: Room on a drive the library uses.

EditStepIn.title: EditStepIn
EditStepIn.description: The edits, in order, made on the picture as it was at `version`.

EditingOut.title: EditingOut
EditingOut.description:
Where each editing model runs now: SAM reading a picture (each click after is on the
processor), erasing at Fast and Best, cutting out at Fast and Best.

EraseIn.title: EraseIn
EraseIn.description: Erase what's picked or painted, filled from what's around it.

FolderNode.title: FolderNode
FolderNode.description: A folder inside a library folder.

Fraction.title: Fraction
Fraction.description:
A part of the picture, as fractions of its width and height (extending, a canvas starts
before the picture and ends after it).

GroupTag.title: GroupTag
GroupTag.description: A group of duplicates or a burst, on the tile of a picture kept from it.

Held.title: Held
Held.description: A job waiting while its picture is open in another app.

Library.title: Library
Library.description: The whole library in numbers, for Home.

LookHereIn.title: LookHereIn
LookHereIn.description:
The look step on a picture's page: on the whole picture, or only on parts picked as Select
picks them, on the picture as its edits left it.

LookIn.title: LookIn
LookIn.description: The look step: a look by its id, at a strength, with its touches.

LookStep.title: LookStep
LookStep.description: A look, with its strength and touches: the Looks tab's choices.

Making.title: Making
Making.description: A wallpaper Mado makes, or made.

OpenIn.title: OpenIn
OpenIn.description:
Paths to open: dropped, picked, pasted (files copied in File Explorer, or a path copied
as words), or opened from File Explorer, Open with or the command line.

PartIn.title: PartIn
PartIn.description:
A part: the clicks that picked it, and which of the three answers (smallest first) is
shown; none, as Mado picks.

PickIn.title: PickIn
PickIn.description:
Which pictures: ticked (`ids`), a folder (`folder`, `dir`), what a search found (`search`,
with `q`), the favourites (with `q`, those a search found among them), or files and folders
dropped, picked, pasted, or opened from File Explorer (`paths`).

PictureRef.title: PictureRef
PictureRef.description: A picture in the library, enough to show its thumbnail or open it.

Place.title: Place
Place.description: Where a monitor sits with the gap for its bezels, in pixels.

PutBack.title: PutBack
PutBack.description: The latest review, every picture of it put back.

QueueNow.title: QueueNow
QueueNow.description: The queue in a word, for the rail's badge and the status bar.

RecipeIn.title: RecipeIn
RecipeIn.description: A recipe: the edits, the size step, then the look step; any can be left out.

Region.title: Region
Region.description: A part of the picture made, in its pixels.

ReviewLine.title: ReviewLine
ReviewLine.description:
A review of duplicates and bursts as History's one line for it: what it set aside, and
what puts all of it back.

SearchProblem.title: SearchProblem
SearchProblem.description:
A reader that couldn't run: reading waits on it till Go on (`/search/resume`) or the next
scan, the other reader reading on.

SearchState.title: SearchState
SearchState.description: How far reading the library for search has got, and what it waits for.

SelectIn.title: SelectIn
SelectIn.description:
The parts picked so far, and a click: one starts a part, an Alt-click (`keep` false) takes
from the part it's in. `edits` are the edits made so far: the parts are picked on the picture
as they left it.

ShownGroup.title: ShownGroup
ShownGroup.description: A group as the review showed it.

SizeIn.title: SizeIn
SizeIn.description: The size step, as the Size tab asks for it.

SizeStep.title: SizeStep
SizeStep.description: Make it for a screen: the Size tab's choices, each picture's own subject and model.

StrokeIn.title: StrokeIn
StrokeIn.description:
A stroke of the brush: its points as fractions of the picture, its width as a fraction of
the picture's shorter side, and whether it takes away (Alt).

SubjectIn.title: SubjectIn
SubjectIn.description: Cut out the picture's subject, found without a click.

Words.title: Words
Words.description: A step, or a batch's save, as the steps and a recipe's line say it.

WordsPiece.title: WordsPiece
WordsPiece.description: A stretch of a picture's words, marked when it's a word the search matched.

WordsReader.title: WordsReader
WordsReader.description:
The reader of the words in pictures: the owner's choice, the one in use, its model (Best)
or Windows' languages (Fast), and where Best reads.

Yours.title: Yours
Yours.description: Mado's record of the owner's own wallpaper, from before it set one.
